label: Scenario 4
title: Scenario 4: right arm picks the Bhindi box, hands it to the left arm in the air, WALLX puts it into zone 1

steps.title: Harness call (read the label, route to zone 1)
steps.detail: Code 420/95126/001 = ZIP 951 → blue lane → zone 1 (left). The harness tries the QR, then the printed ZIP; this run used the preset demo code for the Bhindi box (source 'demo').
steps.what: label → lane → acting arm → target zone

steps.title: Harness call (pick + handover)
steps.detail: The harness runs a stored scenario-4 trajectory (59 s, 32 rows per call): right arm picks the box and hands it to the left claw in the air.

sub.text: right arm moves from home to above the box (claw closed)
right claw opens and lowers around the box
right claw closes on the box (grasp)
right arm lifts the box to the handover point (~18 cm up, table centre)
left claw opens and reaches in
left claw closes on the box: both claws hold it
right claw opens: the box is in the left claw only

steps.title: Harness call (right arm backs off)
steps.detail: Slow harness move (≤ 4 cm per call): right claw lifts and moves away to (0.35, 0.20, 0.26) m so it cannot hit the box or the left arm.

steps.title: Harness call (right arm home)
steps.detail: Slow harness move to home, claw closed. From here the right arm stays parked.

steps.title: WALLX places the box into zone 1 (left arm)
steps.prompt: Stretch to the top left corner of the table and put the purple box into zone 1.
steps.detail: WALLX (wall-x 2610-dualhead-v2, organisers' server) gets the HEAD camera image (the harness sends black wrist images: the held box blocks the left wrist camera, so it only confuses WALLX) + both arms' state + this sentence every call, and returns an action chunk for both arms. The harness LOCKS the right arm (its WALLX actions are replaced by 'hold still'), runs 40% of each chunk per call (--slow 0.4, smoother and safer), and keeps the same sub-goal across calls (--no-reset-on-subgoal). 40 calls. WALLX alone decides where to move, how to lower and where to set the box down.

steps.title: Harness call (release)
steps.detail: The left claw opens fully where WALLX left it, then lifts 8 cm straight up, so the box stays inside zone 1.

steps.title: Harness call (both arms home)
steps.detail: Slow harness move of both arms to home (≤ 5 cm per call).

steps.title: Done
steps.detail: Session ends; video, every call (state, actions, images) and the log are saved.

label: Scenario 3
title: Scenario 3: the harness flips the label-down mailer label up, WALLX picks it up and puts it into zone 1

steps.title: Harness call (flip the bag label up)
steps.detail: The harness runs a stored scenario-3 trajectory (34 s, 32 rows per call) with the left arm: pick the label-down mailer, turn it over, set it down label up, lift away.

sub.text: left arm moves to the bag
left claw opens and lowers onto the bag
left claw closes on the bag (grasp)
left arm lifts and turns the bag over
bag set down label up, claw opens
left arm lifts away (WALLX starts from here)

steps.title: WALLX picks the bag up and puts it into zone 1 (left arm)
steps.prompt: Pick up the white bag and stretch to the top left corner of the table to put it into zone 1.
steps.detail: WALLX (wall-x 2610-dualhead-v2, organisers' server) starts right where the harness left the arm. Every call it gets the HEAD camera image (black wrist images) + both arms' state + this sentence and returns an action chunk for both arms. The harness LOCKS the right arm, runs 40% of each chunk per call (--slow 0.4) and keeps the same sub-goal (--no-reset-on-subgoal). 60 calls. WALLX alone decides how to grasp the bag, where to carry it and where to set it down.

steps.title: Harness call (release)
steps.detail: The left claw opens fully where WALLX left it, then lifts 8 cm straight up.

steps.title: Harness call (both arms home)
steps.detail: Slow harness move of both arms to home (≤ 5 cm per call).

steps.title: Done
steps.detail: Session ends; video, every call (state, actions, images) and the log are saved.

right claw opens and lowers over the box
